title: Coastal Carolina University, Sands Hall, Room 113 'New Music Room' (open room) — sheet A1 of 2, no booth placed
anchor: plan-vector: the sheet's own dimension string 38'-2 1/8" (E-W, north wall face to face). The stated drawing scale 1/2" = 1'-0" on a 24x36 sheet gives 1 pt = 1/3"; the vector faces measure 1374.42 pt = 458.14" against the stated 458.125" (0.015" apart), and the 35'-1 1/8" string measures 1263.42 pt = 421.14" against 421.125" — both strings confirm the scale independently.
interpretations: Plan is a vector PDF (one page, /Rotate 270, outlined text, ~4600 paths). Coordinates were read from PyMuPDF get_drawings() and mapped through page.rotation_matrix so plan-up is page-up. Plan-up is taken as north: the sheet carries no north arrow.

Every wall face is drawn as a pair of lines 1.86 pt (0.62") apart, light grey (0.65) on the room side and darker grey (0.41) behind it. The light line is taken as the interior finished face: with it, both stated strings reproduce to 0.015". Using the dark line would make the room 1.24" larger on each axis and contradict both strings.

Both client PDFs carry identical geometry: 22,762 path items, every one matching in kind and coordinates to 0.01 pt after rotation. They differ only in metadata (one Acrobat Distiller, one PDFium re-save). The take-off is from A1-prelim.pdf.

Sub-runs on the south and west walls are scaled from the vector faces at 1 pt = 1/3" and rounded to the nearest 1/8". Each reading was within 0.02" of the recorded value (178.00, 12.00, 18.00, 261.02, 7.12, 403.14), and the rounded south-side runs sum EXACTLY to the stated 38'-2 1/8" and the west-side runs EXACTLY to 35'-1 1/8" — an independent cross-check, since nothing forced them to.

The stated 38'-2 1/8" string sits at y = 1238 pt, above the pilasters, so it is the full north-wall width face to face. The 35'-1 1/8" string sits at x = 1805 pt, clear of the pilasters, so it is the full east-wall height face to face.

Two pilasters on the south wall, both 18" deep (N-S): one filling the south-west corner (7 1/8" wide E-W, so the west wall's lower 18" steps east by 7 1/8"), and one free-standing 12" wide, whose east face is 14'-10" from the east wall. They are recorded as runs (notches in the polygon), not features.

One door, north wall near the north-west corner. The wall break in the drawing is 40.02" (599.58 to 719.64 pt), with a 2" frame at each side; the leaf is drawn open 90 deg into room 113 at 36" x 1 3/4" (108 x 5.28 pt), hinged at the west jamb, and the arc closes on the east jamb. Recorded as the 36" frame opening, 6 1/8" from the north-west corner (wall break begins 4 1/8" from the corner). Clear passage through the frame for delivery is less than 36" and is NOT on the plan.

Room 113's east wall (to 112 / 113A / 113B) has no opening on this sheet; the door drawn near it belongs to the 113A/113B partition. The north wall's exterior face has a small stub wall in the corridor at about 1658-1673 pt; it is outside room 113 and not modelled. The north wall is drawn with a dashed hatch (likely a rated wall) — not modelled.
Wall thickness on the plan reads 14.64 pt = 4 7/8" (north, west and east walls). Built at the 4" house default because thickness is cosmetic and never moves an interior dimension.

The sheet's notes say every dimension is to be field verified by the manufacturer. Both stated strings are tagged '(SEE NOTES BELOW)'. Every number here is therefore a plan reading, not a site measurement.
Sheet 2 (the A-I practice-room layout) was not supplied. No booth is placed.
